picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena—from sand to folding proteins—in a single deep-learning architecture, a genuine step toward general-purpose scientific AI.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's independent AI-based confirmation of the iconic Event Horizon Telescope black hole image, published in Nature, strengthens confidence in one of astrophysics' most celebrated results.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: ARPA-H's up to $53 million award to an MIT-led team to use generative AI for safer herbicide discovery is a major federal bet on AI-driven chemistry with direct agricultural and public-health stakes.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Carnegie Mellon's new 'Workspace Models' memory approach lets robots recall past observations cheaply, addressing a core bottleneck in deploying AI-driven robots in real-world settings.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics firm Unitree to build a joint embodied-AI lab signals deepening academia-industry integration in one of the fastest-moving areas of applied AI.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign AI research—spanning physical AI, agentic AI, and cybersecurity—reflects Europe's push for AI independence from US and Chinese platforms.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: Reported ties between Nvidia's CEO and a figure linked to a suspected espionage case raise serious national-security questions given Nvidia's central role in the global AI hardware supply chain.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security

picks.editorial_note: SMU's $4.2 million NIST award to build an AI- and robotics-driven Digital Twin Lab ties academic research directly to semiconductor manufacturing and workforce needs.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: A UConn symposium on a proposed $1 billion, 15-year AI investment for frontline social service workers highlights real policy stakes for how AI is deployed around vulnerable populations.
picks.title: Experts Explore How AI Could Affect Vulnerable Communities, Social Service Providers - UConn Today

picks.editorial_note: A $5 million NSF-funded multi-institutional project led by the University of Georgia to build an open radio access network for extended reality applications advances AI-optimized wireless infrastructure.
picks.title: $5M NSF grant to grow extended reality technologies
